items.problem: `notify_cue` skips a tutorial whose step progress is stopped, as `open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/tutorial-core.md:91` requires ("While stopped, it does not receive the condition of `complete`"), but no test goes through it. In `client/godot/core/tutorial_core/tests/`, `notify_cue` is called only outside the stop: `test_scene.gd` never calls it, and `test_watch.gd:24` calls it before the scene change. Run path of the missing test: `SceneEndedEvent`, then `notify_cue` with the current `cue` of a stopped step, expecting `false` and the same step after `SceneStartedEvent`. Removing the `STOPPED` condition fails no test by reading the tests; this was not run. The code is outside the commit range

`_frame_waiting` keeps a `Paused` tutorial from becoming `Shown` while a system popup is visible (`tutorial-core.md:94`, "no `Shown` transition of 2"), but no test goes through it. The only tests that open a system popup (`test_input.gd:19`, `test_view.gd:149`) do so while the tutorial is already `Shown`, so `_shown != null` skips the transition whatever `system_popup` is. Removing `system_popup` from this condition fails no test by reading the tests; this was not run. The code is outside the commit range

`_hide` deletes the `Tutorial` view focus with an empty list (`tutorial-core.md:88`), but no test checks that the focus is gone after the tutorial view is hidden, or that it stays while the view is hidden because of a system popup. `has_focus` is asserted only in `test_input.gd` `test_cue_and_requirement_steps_have_no_tutorial_view_focus`, on steps that never set a focus, and the gamepad tests end without a focus check after the step ends. Removing `_clear_focus` here fails no test by reading the tests; this was not run. The code is outside the commit range

A step without `text` hides the speech bubble (`tutorial-core.md:75`), but no row of `test-data/data/tables/tutorial_step.csv` has an empty `text`, so this branch and the `not step.text.is_empty()` guard of the bind at line 1144 never run in a test. The code is outside the commit range

A step without `anchor` puts the speech bubble at the position set in the tutorial view resource (`tutorial-core.md:108`), but no test asserts that position. `_bubble_home` appears in the tests only as the reset value at `test_lifecycle.gd:46`, and the bubble assertions of `test_view.gd` all use a step with `anchor`. Removing lines 1146 and 1147 fails no test by reading the tests; this was not run. The code is outside the commit range

"When equal, below" of `tutorial-core.md:108` has no test. The one test whose anchor has equal room on both sides is `test_view.gd:85` (50 above and 50 below the anchor), and its assert at line 96 accepts either the top edge or the bottom edge of the view root. Changing `below >= above` to `below > above` moves the speech bubble to the top edge and still passes that assert by reading the test; this was not run. The code is outside the commit range

The handling of a `can_start_tutorial` hook that returns a value that is not a `bool` (`open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:246`, an error log and `false`) has no test. The test hook `_can_start` at `tests/support/tutorial_test_case.gd:233` always returns a `bool` or throws, and no test registers another hook that returns a non-`bool` value. The code is outside the commit range

`test_with_gamepad_supported_an_anchor_without_a_ui_button_logs_its_name` asserts only `errors() == 1`, but `tutorial-core.md:253` requires an error log with the anchor name. `UnitTestCore.check_logs` (`client/godot/core/unit_test_core/dev/unit_test_core.gd:1290`) counts by level and tag and does not read the message, so dropping the anchor name from the log at `tutorial_core.gd:953` fails no test. The contents that `tutorial-core.md:141` and `:143` set for the step check error (tutorial ID and `step`) and the anchor wait warn (anchor name, anchor key) are unchecked in the same way, in `test_step_check.gd` and in `test_view.gd` `test_a_step_waiting_for_its_anchor_logs_one_warn_after_the_wait_time`. Checked by reading; this was not run. The code is outside the commit range
